items.html: And another time I heard that the nine points that come to her by way of additions — they are what descend below to Beria. But the root point cannot descend to Beria in any way; and through the sacrifices and the songs and the prayer of Yotzer and Shaharit, then we raise all the sparks of Atzilut that descended into these worlds, and also the nine points of the Nukva of Atzilut herself, as is explained by us at length in the order of the morning prayer. However, the truth of this matter was explained at length in the discourses of the Tefillin, on the reason why Tefillin are worn by day and not at night; and there this entire discourse is explained well, from the beginning to the end, in all the discourses of the night, and there is the truth of this matter.
